verdict.rationale:
Bruno stores collections natively as plain-text .bru files directly on the user's filesystem, with no cloud sync, account, or vendor lock-in, meaning a user's data is always already in an open, portable format and can be taken elsewhere (e.g. committed to Git or moved to another tool) with no explicit 'export' step required. This is corroborated by community testimonials describing collections as 'plain text files in Git' and users switching away from Postman/Insomnia by adopting Bruno's local file model.
Missing for 10: no explicit bulk 'export all data' feature/button documented, and no independent verification of full fidelity when migrating away from Bruno to another tool.
